name: ConfigCat
summary: ConfigCat prices feature flags by plan rather than by seat, with unlimited seats and unlimited flag reads on every tier. A Forever Free plan allows 10 flags, Pro costs $110 a month for 100 flags, and Smart costs $325 for unlimited flags.

facts.text: Targeting rules per flag are capped at 4 on Forever Free, 8 on Pro and unlimited on Smart and above.
Audit log retention is 7 days on Forever Free, 35 days on Pro and Smart, and 2 years on Enterprise and Dedicated.
The pricing page offers a saving of up to 10% on annual billing but does not list annual prices.
SDKs cover .NET, Android, C++, Dart, Elixir, Go, Java, JavaScript, Kotlin Multiplatform, PHP, Python, Ruby, Rust, Swift, Unity and Unreal Engine.
